scope: Candidate Search ad templates for ten published storefront locales; root owns verified geography, landing routing, campaign assembly and approval.
product_truth_basis: Finished matching mother-and-daughter dresses; each person’s item and size are selected separately; check product details and size guide.
language_setting_note: The September 2026 Search language-settings removal rollout means language matching must be planned through creative and verified landing language, plus supported geographic routing. The root must verify current account UI and policy; do not assume a language-target field remains available.
negative_keyword_note: Candidate phrase negatives cover only sewing-pattern and how-to-sew intent. They are not account-wide upload instructions. Check actual search terms, native usage, segmentation, and false positives before application. Literal substring checks below do not simulate Google matching and do not prove all variants are covered.
keyword_note: Exact seeds are research candidates only. No search volume, CPC, auction eligibility, conversion, or profit qualification has been established. Previously deferred candidates stay deferred.
country_note: Language presence is not country targeting, market eligibility, shipping availability or paid-readiness proof. No countries are added by this artifact.

character_validation.method: NFC text; each Unicode code point counts one, except Unicode East Asian Width W or F counts two. Combining marks count separately as a conservative estimate. Google Ads final editor acceptance remains unverified.

country_assignment.note: Do not create new country targets from a language alone.
